verdict.rationale: Fellow's own docs say the product automatically generates AI meeting summaries, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes inside the product, which covers in-product AI suggestions from the user's meeting data. Broader insight generation across data is thin: 'Ask Fellow' appears only as a pricing line item, and the richer Q&A runs through external AI assistants via MCP rather than inside Fellow. missing for 10: documented in-product cross-meeting insights or Q&A (Ask Fellow details), proactive insights beyond per-meeting recaps, independent or hands-on corroboration of AI output quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: You automatically receive a clear meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting.
Fellow records, transcribes, and summarizes every meeting across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack huddles
